answer: Make every identity climb a ridge of escalating tasks: each step's puzzle is derived from that identity's own past answers, so solutions cannot be copied or pooled across clones, and each step costs more time than the last. Copying another identity's work drops the copier to its nadir — zero progress, staircase reset. Only identities that reach the summit may drink from the shared oasis pool, so a farm of a thousand clones still pays a thousand full climbs for one shared sip.
